title: Sangerra kattat
intro: cayli korridoritteh addat, fayyale caddo le numih qaxmaqaane gersi baadal tan taama abeyna luk kacanu tekke. Tama kacni ittallakle tekkooka kataaseeh, aamantinaane gibbataah, qeltut tan numma taybulleem kee ellecaboh taama abeynit currik tanim diggoysaanama.
clues: Anu elle waaram Qabli baaxol, kaxxa diihay le daala.
Qunxa num yi buxah adda yemeeteeh, kay geyto yi baadal sabhalal mali.
Anu kaa aylahsam gabbateh, takkay immay usug isi Rabbih dabboh gorrise.
Anu kay sartan darrek qanxiseh, takkay immay sumaq yi aylahso yascasse.
massakaxxa le sayyoh camitte tibba haanam, koboxuh ken arcibiseh afle duyye gabat ken hee.
ellecaboh, anu qaduuk inni qellat oggoleh, nummat mamaxxaga amoytak foocal.

Is kaaytah tan silaytut finqitteh sugte

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
